name: Mass-spectrometric identity and site-table operations
description: Expose selected published product, peptide or phosphosite identifications and quantify declared table contrasts while preserving analyte/site identity, replicate structure, normalization, censoring and missingness.

inputs.source: actual table/workbook or supplied identification file
inputs.selector: exact analyte, peptide/site, protein and sample keys
inputs.metadata: column meanings, units, ratios, normalization and missingness definitions

outputs.rows: native cells with site/analyte identity and replicate/sample correspondence
outputs.missingness: unmeasured, censored and observed values kept separate

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

inputs.expression: explicit ratio, log difference, exponentiation or mass difference

outputs.result: descriptive derived values with exact inputs
outputs.scope: response-ratio, abundance or occupancy meaning only when source warrants it

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

capability_operations.operation: Analyze raw spectra against selected identities

inputs.spectra: actual raw/open spectral data and acquisition metadata
inputs.search_or_fit_model: declared peptide/metabolite library, modification list, scoring and error model

outputs.candidate_identifications: matches, ambiguity and support under that model
outputs.quantification: pipeline-specific estimates with controls and uncertainty

capability_operations.invocation_note: Normalized capability contract; the confirmed callable list identifies existing related primitives only, not interchangeable signatures.

repository_catalog_defined: source.xlsx.sheets/rows and generic source readers are repository-defined; no raw-MS search/quantification engine confirmed.
research_operations_performed: organism/yeag/trace.json: six selected 2021 phosphosite rows decoded directly from the workbook; selected response-ratio calculations reproduced.
cellular YhcB source work extracted processed phenotype/genetic rows, not raw MS.
capability_specifications_not_confirmed_: Raw proteomics/metabolomics identification, isotope fitting, occupancy correction and new compound identification require files and software not supplied by this catalog.
author_experiments_are_source_evidence_o: LC-MS/NMR/product synthesis, native activity purification and phosphorylation assays are authors evidence; no sample or spectral acquisition is available here.
availability.binding_limit: A repository catalog definition is confirmed source-code identity, not proof of caller enablement, service availability, installed dependencies or execution in this research. Research scripts are retained operations, not registered runtime tools.

limits: Nonzero intensity with missing ratio is not analyte absence or zero effect.
A normalized ratio is not automatically absolute abundance, occupancy fraction or protein-abundance-corrected phosphorylation.
Analyte disappearance without identified product does not establish the proposed productive reaction.
